claim: The certified ordinary-polytopal selected nerves for H9/14 records 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, and 9 admit no compact hyperbolic Coxeter labeling.

independent_hostile_replay.implementation: No production selected-nerve gate or project Coxeter/Lanner classifier is imported. Classical Lanner representatives are permuted independently, finite Coxeter diagrams are classified independently, and rank-nine faces are rebuilt from the seven polytopality archives.

compact_inputs: Every inclusion-minimal order-four/five nonface in a compact Coxeter nerve supports a classical Lanner diagram.
Every actual rank-nine vertex diagram of a compact hyperbolic Coxeter 9-polytope is elliptic.
For compact H9/14 the complete finite label alphabet is 2, 3, 4, 5.
The complete labelled classical Lanner tables contain 108 order-four and 420 order-five placements.
proof.finite_search: For each selected nerve, reconstruct all rank-nine vertices from its exact minimal-nonface clutter. Join complete Lanner placement tables in the frozen overlap order and, after each join, require every restriction induced by every actual rank-nine vertex to remain elliptic. The final state counts for all seven records are zero.
proof.perron_frobenius_step: On an actual-vertex restriction write the normalized Coxeter Gram matrix as G=I-A, with A symmetric and entrywise nonnegative. Ellipticity is rho(A)<1. Replacing an unforced right angle by any finite non-right angle gives A'>=A entrywise and rho(A')>=rho(A). Therefore a sparse restriction already rejected as non-elliptic cannot be repaired by labels outside the joined supports.
proof.why_no_gram_stage_is_needed: Every finite Coxeter labeling fails a necessary positive-definite principal vertex condition before global Lorentzian rank or inertia can be tested.
